intentional_issues.title: Product and site identifiers differ across PLM, MES and ERP
intentional_issues.planted: Each product has a different identifier in each system: VX-2170: PLM VX-2170 / ERP MAT-10004721 / MES VX2170_R7; VX-LFP50: PLM VX-LFP50 / ERP MAT-10004755 / MES LFP50-PR-A. The plant is ERP plant MI01 and MES site HOLLAND-01.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: PLM, ERP and MES are administered by different teams and assign their own keys.
intentional_issues.truth: The identifiers refer to the same two products and the same plant.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: PLM/product_master.xlsx ERP_MATERIAL_NO; MES/item_master.csv plm_part_ref; ERP descriptions contain the PLM number; COMPANY/company_and_facility.xlsx Facilities sheet maps ERP_PLANT to MES_SITE.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Reconcile each product and the plant to a single identity using the cross-references in the customer files, and show the mapping with its source fields.

intentional_issues.title: Eastbay Separator ultimate parent not disclosed
intentional_issues.planted: SUPPLIER_EVIDENCE/EastbaySeparator_Supplier_Declaration_2026.pdf page 1 states 'Ultimate parent: Not disclosed - confidential'; ERP supplier master notes only the Singapore immediate parent.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Foreign suppliers commonly disclose the immediate holding company but decline to identify beneficial owners.
intentional_issues.truth: Ultimate parent is Huaying Advanced Materials Group Co., Ltd. (China), 62% indirect ownership. This appears ONLY in ground_truth.json.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: Immediate parent Eastbay Holdings Pte. Ltd. (Singapore). Ultimate parent not disclosed.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Mark the ultimate-parent fact for Eastbay Separator as MISSING EVIDENCE and flag the lots that consumed MAT-30000415 for review. Do not state, guess or infer the ultimate parent.

intentional_issues.title: Nordvik electrolyte attestation expired 2026-06-30, no renewal on file
intentional_issues.planted: SUPPLIER_EVIDENCE/NordvikElectrolyte_Supplier_Attestation_2025-2026.pdf covers materials delivered through 2026-06-30. No later Nordvik attestation exists in the customer files.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Annual supplier attestations lapse when procurement does not chase renewals.
intentional_issues.truth: A renewal for 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 was signed by Nordvik but never sent to Volterra.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: Electrolyte lots in MES/material_consumption.csv with component_lot_received after 2026-06-30 are not covered by any attestation on file.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Mark electrolyte supplier evidence as EXPIRED for finished lots that consumed MAT-30000520 lots received after 2026-06-30, and flag those lots for review. Lots using electrolyte received on or before 2026-06-30 are supported. Do not assume a renewal exists.

intentional_issues.title: VX-2170 BOM revision C effective 2026-07-01 (separator change)
intentional_issues.planted: PLM/bom.xlsx and PLM/product_master.xlsx contain VX-2170 revision B (2026-01-15 to 2026-06-30) and revision C (from 2026-07-01, ECN-2026-031). Revision C replaces RM-SEP-016 (Tamarack) with RM-SEP-021 (Eastbay).
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Engineering change notices switch suppliers mid-year for cost reasons.
intentional_issues.truth: Lots started on or after 2026-07-01 were built to revision C; MES consumption confirms MAT-30000415 was used.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: BOM effectivity dates; MES consumption of MAT-30000415 only on lots started on or after 2026-07-01.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Assign each VX-2170 lot to the BOM revision in effect on its production start date and evaluate supplier evidence against that revision's materials.

intentional_issues.title: No qualification report covers VX-2170 revision C
intentional_issues.planted: QUALITY/ contains VX2170_RevB_Qualification_Report.pdf only. Page 1 states the report applies only to revision B.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Re-qualification after a material change is often scheduled but not completed before production continues.
intentional_issues.truth: Revision C cells have the same rated capacity (5.0 Ah); they were simply never re-tested and documented.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: No test report for VX-2170 revision C. PLM still lists 5.0 Ah for revision C.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Mark capacity and specification evidence for VX-2170 revision C lots as MISSING and flag for review. The estimate may use the PLM value 5.0 Ah, labelled as not supported by a test report.

intentional_issues.title: VX-LFP50 rated capacity conflict: PLM 50.0 Ah vs draft test report 48.6 Ah
intentional_issues.planted: PLM/product_master.xlsx RATED_CAPACITY_AH = 50.0; QUALITY/VXLFP50_RevA_Qualification_Report_DRAFT.pdf page 3 'Declared rated capacity: 48.6 Ah'. The report is a draft with no reviewer signature.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: PLM attributes often hold the design target and are not updated after test results.
intentional_issues.truth: True rated capacity is 48.6 Ah; the PLM value is a stale design target.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: Two sources disagree; the only test evidence is an unapproved draft.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Mark VX-LFP50 rated capacity as CONFLICTING, show the credit under both values ($54,432.00 to $56,000.00), mark neither as supported, and flag for review.

intentional_issues.title: MES order confirmation exceeds finished-lot quantity for MO-26-0171 by 62 cells
intentional_issues.planted: MES/production_orders.csv MO-26-0171 qty_good = 6212; MES/material_consumption.csv fg_lot_qty for lot V21260706 = 6150, and material consumed corresponds to 6150 good + 288 scrap cells.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Order confirmations are sometimes double-posted after rework while the lot record is correct.
intentional_issues.truth: 6150 good cells; 62 reworked cells were confirmed twice.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: Two MES records disagree by 62 cells; material consumption supports the lower figure.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Flag the 62-cell discrepancy on MO-26-0171 for review and use the finished-lot quantity (6150) for available-to-sell calculations, showing both values.

intentional_issues.title: B-grade invoice line cannot be linked to an eligible product or production lot
intentional_issues.planted: ERP/sales.csv invoice 90041233: MATNR MAT-10004759 'VXLFP50 CELL B-GRADE', 140 EA to Circuit Loop Recycling LLC, no batch (CHARG blank). MAT-10004759 is not in the PLM product master or MES item master.
intentional_issues.why_realistic: Off-spec product is sold to recyclers under separate material numbers outside normal lot tracking.
intentional_issues.truth: Downgraded VX-LFP50 cells set aside from 2026 scrap counts after failing outgoing capacity QC.
intentional_issues.customer_evidence: Description resembles VX-LFP50 but no identifier or lot links it to an eligible product.
intentional_issues.expected_behavior: Exclude the line from the credit estimate and flag it for review as an unmatched sales record. Do not map it to VX-LFP50 based on the description.

tax_rules_applied.BATTERY_CELL_RATE_PER_KWH: Form 7207 (Rev. December 2025), Part II, line 5a, column (c): 'Battery cell ... kilowatt-hour basis $ 35.00' (docs/compliance/f7207.pdf, page 1).
tax_rules_applied.BATTERY_CELL_MIN_ENERGY_DENSITY_WH_PER_L: Instructions for Form 7207 (Rev. December 2025), Line 5a: 'an energy density of not less than 100 watt-hours per liter' (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 5).
tax_rules_applied.BATTERY_CELL_MIN_ENERGY_WH: Instructions for Form 7207, Line 5a: 'capable of storing at least 12 watt-hours of energy' (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 5).
tax_rules_applied.BATTERY_CELL_MAX_CAPACITY_TO_POWER_RATIO: Instructions for Form 7207, Line 5a: 'the capacity must not exceed a capacity-to-power ratio not exceeding 100:1' (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 5).
tax_rules_applied.CAPACITY_KWH_BASIS: Instructions for Form 7207, Column (d) for lines 5a-5c: aggregate capacity is 'the number of eligible components produced and sold by the capacity of each component expressed on a kilowatt-hour basis' (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 5).
tax_rules_applied.PHASE_OUT_FACTOR: Instructions for Form 7207, 'Phase out and termination': the credit phases out for eligible components sold after 2029 (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 3). 2026 sales therefore use 100%.
tax_rules_applied.QUALIFIED_SALE: Instructions for Form 7207, Special Rules - Qualified sales (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 2).

assumptions.assumption: kWh per cell = nominal voltage (V) x rated capacity (Ah) / 1000, using the rated capacity declared in the qualification report.
assumptions.why: The Form 7207 instructions express capacity on a kWh basis but the source documents in docs/compliance/ do not specify which test value (rated vs. measured mean) to use. Rated capacity is the conservative, conventional basis.

assumptions.assumption: Only sales invoiced in calendar 2026 count toward the 2026 credit; all 2026 sales are of cells produced in 2026.
assumptions.why: Production starts in 2026 and there is no opening inventory, so no cross-year production/sale timing question arises.

assumptions.assumption: Volterra claims credits only for battery cells. Electrode active materials and other inputs are purchased from suppliers and are not claimed by Volterra.

unresolved_rules.topic: Material assistance from prohibited foreign entities (material assistance cost ratio)
unresolved_rules.why: The Form 7207 instructions state that eligible components may not include material assistance from a prohibited foreign entity for tax years beginning after July 4, 2025 (docs/compliance/i7207--2025.pdf, page 2), but the official calculation methodology and threshold guidance are not among the documents in docs/compliance/. The dataset supplies the inputs (BOM quantities, purchase prices, supplier evidence); no pass/fail is computed.
